versions.changelog:
Initial release of 2chat-whatsapp skill.

- Enables sending and receiving WhatsApp messages (Web + Business API), SMS, and voice call records via 2Chat.
- Allows management of WhatsApp Business API (WABA) templates, channels, contacts, and WhatsApp catalogs.
- Supports publishing WhatsApp statuses and browsing conversations and groups.
- Integrates with OpenClaw through OAuth 2.1 (browser sign-in), storing no API keys or credentials.
- Includes detailed usage guidance, tool listing, and clear setup instructions for connecting OpenClaw to 2Chat MCP.
